name: Trees and green
description: Where the trees stand and how tall they are, where the green land is, and how green the ground reads from the air.

variants.name: Trees
variants.title: Tree canopy
variants.description: Every tree of 2.5 m and taller, by its height above the ground, from the RIVM tree map. Cells under a building are left out.

classify.title: Tree height
classify.note: Trees of 2.5 m and taller, height above the ground, from AHN and the infrared aerial photo, left out under buildings. RIVM, {year}.

variants.name: Green
variants.title: Green cover
variants.description: Grass, shrubs and trees, by how the land is protected: farmland, Natura 2000, the Nature Network or none. The classes do not say what kind of green it is. From the RIVM green map.

classify.title: Green land, by protection
classify.note: Grass, shrubs and trees in 5 m cells. The classes say how the land is protected (farmland, Natura 2000, Nature Network or none), not what kind of green it is. RIVM green map, {year}.

variants.name: NDVI
variants.title: Vegetation index
variants.description: How green the ground reads in the summer infrared aerial photo, as an approximate NDVI.

classify.title: Vegetation index (NDVI)
classify.note: Approximate NDVI (Rouse et al. 1974), (near infrared − red) / (near infrared + red), from the {year} summer infrared aerial photo. The photo is colour-corrected, not calibrated, so compare places on this site only.
